note: A rectified street-panorama crop of one Amsterdam house front. The photo may have shadow, glare or a colour cast from the camera.

wall_colour.instructions: Which swatch is closest to the true colour of the main wall of the house front in `facade` above the ground floor (the colour the wall would have in neutral daylight)? Ignore shadows, bright glare and any colour cast from the camera; judge the paint or brick itself, and ignore white window frames, trim and the sky.

criteria.near_black_painted: Near-black, charcoal or very dark grey painted wall.
criteria.pale_salmon_brick: Pale salmon, pinkish or light brown-grey brick.
criteria.white_plaster: White or cream plaster or painted white wall.
criteria.grey_stone: Mid grey stone, concrete or grey brick.
